units: Selected factual annotations, no exhaustive event count
note: Original paraphrases with primary citations. Coordinates approximate named city/region anchors, not footprints. A date may mark a reporting cutoff rather than the onset of an event; the card says which.

items.title: Crimea referendum
items.text: The UN General Assembly declared the 16 March referendum invalid in its 27 March resolution, reaffirming Ukraine’s internationally recognized territorial integrity.

items.title: Donetsk
items.text: OHCHR’s eastern-Ukraine detention study begins on 14 April 2014 and covers Government actors and armed groups in Donetsk and Luhansk areas. This is the study window, not a claimed start date for every incident.

items.title: Luhansk
items.text: The same OHCHR report addresses arbitrary detention and ill-treatment by multiple actors through April 2021.

items.title: Eight years before the invasion
items.text: OHCHR describes hostilities over control in eastern Ukraine during the eight years preceding the full-scale attack. This year-end locator summarizes the period rather than a new battle.

items.title: Human rights across the divide
items.text: OHCHR’s study includes case studies of detention by the Security Service of Ukraine in Kharkiv and an armed-group detention facility in Donetsk. Protection obligations apply to every actor.
